The petitioners vide the present petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 seek quashing of FIR No.0304/2021 dated 30.05.2021 registered under Sections 406/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at PS.: Pul Prahladpur, Delhi and all proceeding emanating therefrom in view of the Settlement Deed dated 12.04.2022 arrived at between the parties.

2. This petition is accompanied by the Settlement Deed dated 12.04.2022 and is also supported by affidavits of all the petitioners and of respondent no.2, alongwith proofs of their respective I.Ds.

Petitioner nos.1 to 5 and as also respondent no.2 are present in Court and have been identified by the Investigating Officer.
Their credentials have been verified by this Court.
4. Issue Notice.
5. Learned APP accepts notice.
She confirms that she has no objection to the quashing of the said FIR.

sentences.text: Respondent no.2 confirms that the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 17.10.2022.

She further affirms the Settlement Deed dated 12.04.2022 whereby the petitioner no.1 has agreed to pay respondent no.2 a sum of Rs.4,00,000/- out of which Rs.3,00,000/- has already been paid to respondent no.2 and the remaining amount of Rs.1,00,000/- has been handed over to the respondent no. 2 vide DD No.977595 issued on 04.09.2023 on State Bank of India, Branch Flyover Market, Defence Colony in full and final settlement of all her claims including alimony, maintenance (present, past and future),
stridhan etc.
She states that she has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.

7. In view of the settlement arrived at between the parties and following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Jitendra Raghuvanshi & Ors. Vs. Babita Raguvanshi & Anr (2013) 4 SCC 58, Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2014) 6 SCC 466, this Court is of the opinion that continuation of the aforesaid FIR will be an exercise in futility.

9. Accordingly, the present petition alongwith the pending applications, if any, stands disposed of.
